Integrate with respect to \(y\). \[\int_{x^{2}}^{3 x}\left(x y\right)\,dy=\frac{x^{3} \left(9 - x^{2}\right)}{2}\]
Integrate with respect to \(x\). \[\int_{0}^{3}\left(\frac{x^{3} \left(9 - x^{2}\right)}{2}\right)\,dx=\frac{243}{8}\]
Evaluate the opposite order directly as well.
Integrate with respect to \(x\). \[\int_{\frac{y}{3}}^{\sqrt{y}}\left(x y\right)\,dx=\frac{y^{2} \left(9 - y\right)}{18}\]
Integrate with respect to \(y\). \[\int_{0}^{9}\left(\frac{y^{2} \left(9 - y\right)}{18}\right)\,dy=\frac{243}{8}\]

ko: 경계 교점으로 영역을 두 방식으로 쓴다. \[I=\int_{-1}^{2}\int_{y^{2}}^{y + 2}\left(y\right)\,dx\,dy\] \[I=\int_{0}^{1}\int_{- \sqrt{x}}^{\sqrt{x}}\left(y\right)\,dy\,dx+\int_{1}^{4}\int_{x - 2}^{\sqrt{x}}\left(y\right)\,dy\,dx\]
첫 번째 순서는 안쪽 적분이 다항식이다.
en: Boundary intersections give two orders. \[I=\int_{-1}^{2}\int_{y^{2}}^{y + 2}\left(y\right)\,dx\,dy\] \[I=\int_{0}^{1}\int_{- \sqrt{x}}^{\sqrt{x}}\left(y\right)\,dy\,dx+\int_{1}^{4}\int_{x - 2}^{\sqrt{x}}\left(y\right)\,dy\,dx\]
The first order is simpler because the inner integral is polynomial.
Integrate with respect to \(x\). \[\int_{y^{2}}^{y + 2}\left(y\right)\,dx=y \left(- y^{2} + y + 2\right)\]
Integrate with respect to \(y\). \[\int_{-1}^{2}\left(y \left(- y^{2} + y + 2\right)\right)\,dy=\frac{9}{4}\]

en: In the reversed order the inner integral multiplies the integrand by the slice length. \[I=\int_{0}^{1}\int_{0}^{2 x}\left(y \cos{\left(x^{3} - 1 \right)}\right)\,dy\,dx\]
Integrate with respect to \(y\). \[\int_{0}^{2 x}\left(y \cos{\left(x^{3} - 1 \right)}\right)\,dy=2 x^{2} \cos{\left(x^{3} - 1 \right)}\]
Integrate with respect to \(x\). \[\int_{0}^{1}\left(2 x^{2} \cos{\left(x^{3} - 1 \right)}\right)\,dx=\frac{2 \sin{\left(1 \right)}}{3}\]

ko: 왼쪽 경계가 y=0에서 바뀌므로 두 제II형 조각으로 나눈다.
\(x\) 적분을 수행한다. \[\int_{-1}^{- y^{3} + y}\left(y\right)\,dx=y \left(- y^{3} + y + 1\right)\]
\(x\) 적분을 수행한다. \[\int_{\sqrt{y} - 1}^{- y^{3} + y}\left(y\right)\,dx=- y^{\frac{3}{2}} - y^{4} + y^{2} + y\]

Integrate with respect to \(x\). \[\int_{-1}^{- y^{3} + y}\left(y\right)\,dx=y \left(- y^{3} + y + 1\right)\]
Integrate with respect to \(y\). \[\int_{-1}^{0}\left(y \left(- y^{3} + y + 1\right)\right)\,dy=- \frac{11}{30}\]
Integrate with respect to \(x\). \[\int_{\sqrt{y} - 1}^{- y^{3} + y}\left(y\right)\,dx=- y^{\frac{3}{2}} - y^{4} + y^{2} + y\]
Integrate with respect to \(y\). \[\int_{0}^{1}\left(- y^{\frac{3}{2}} - y^{4} + y^{2} + y\right)\,dy=\frac{7}{30}\]
